newsletter.intro: Koko decides to throw a special party for all her forest friends. She invites Lili the ladybug, Snaily the snail, Poki the hedgehog, Gugu the owl, Boingy the frog, Mimi the field mouse, Tiny the ant, Hoppy the bunny, and Turtly the turtle to celebrate together. But when shy Poki feels left out, worrying his spikes will pop the decorations, Koko reminds him that everyone belongs. Poki overcomes his shyness and dances joyfully under the stars! This special ensemble episode celebrates friendship, inclusion, and belonging. The best parties are the ones where everyone feels welcome!

learning_words.meaning: CELEBRATE 慶祝 to do something special for a happy time
INVITE 邀請 to ask someone to come and join you Koko can invite a friend.
HAPPY 快樂 feeling good and full of joy The friends feel happy.

newsletter.parent_activity: Daily mission / 每日任務: Say: "Let's celebrate together!" 讓我們一起慶祝吧! Role play / 角色扮演: Act out inviting each forest friend and helping everyone feel welcome. 演一演邀請每一位森林朋友,並幫助每個人感到受歡迎。 Tip / 小提醒: Everyone deserves to feel welcomed and valued, even if they seem different. The Forest Party

She invites Lili the ladybug, Snaily the snail, Poki the hedgehog, Gugu the owl, Boingy the frog, Mimi the field mouse, Tiny the ant, Hoppy the bunny, and Turtly the turtle to celebrate together. But when shy Poki feels left out, worrying his spikes will pop the decorations, Koko reminds him that everyone belongs. Poki overcomes his shyness and dances joyfully under the stars! This special ensemble episode celebrates friendship, inclusion, and belonging. The best parties are the ones where everyone feels welcome!
